description.tr: Crewhall panolarını Jira işleriyle iki yönlü eşitler: başlık, açıklama, durum, atanan, öncelik, tarih, etiket, puan ve yorumlar. Bana atanan işler, sohbet komutu ve asistan araçları içerir. Jira Cloud ve Data Center ile çalışır.
description.en: Keeps Crewhall boards in two-way sync with Jira issues: title, description, status, assignee, priority, dates, labels, points and comments. Includes your assigned work, a chat command and assistant tools. Works with Jira Cloud and Data Center.

description.tr: Jira işini sohbete getir: /jira ABC-12 ya da /jira ara giriş hatası
description.en: Bring a Jira issue to the chat: /jira ABC-12 or /jira search login bug

tools.name: search_issues
tools.description: Searches the caller's connected Jira issues by text. Read only.

tools.name: my_issues
tools.description: Lists open Jira issues assigned to the caller. Read only.

tools.name: add_issue_comment
tools.description: Adds a comment to a Jira issue the caller can reach.
